sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 361 of 2023 registered at Police Station Piprai, District Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A and 376 (2) (n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. clearly stated that she left her house on her own volition because she wanted to marry present applicant - accused,
however, her parents had fixed her marriage with some other person.
It is further argued that prosecutrix visited various places with the applicant - accused, however, there is no evidence that she ever tried to escape or raised alarm.
Further argument is that applicant is in custody since 02.1.2024.
He is the permanent resident of District Guna (M.P.) having no criminal antecedents and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

On these Pahalwan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93369954/
1 grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: O n the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Pahalwan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93369954/
